statement_amounts.name: statement_amounts
statement_amounts.value: ("account_statements"."opening_balance" IS NULL OR abs("account_statements"."opening_balance")<=1000000000000) AND ("account_statements"."closing_balance" IS NULL OR abs("account_statements"."closing_balance")<=1000000000000) AND ("account_statements"."opening_balance" IS NOT NULL OR "account_statements"."closing_balance" IS NOT NULL)

budget_envelope_amounts.name: budget_envelope_amounts
budget_envelope_amounts.value: "budget_envelopes"."allocated" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND ("budget_envelopes"."imported_carry" IS NULL OR "budget_envelopes"."imported_carry" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

budget_period_amounts.name: budget_period_amounts
budget_period_amounts.value: ("budget_periods"."budgeted_spending" IS NULL OR "budget_periods"."budgeted_spending" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) AND ("budget_periods"."expected_income" IS NULL OR "budget_periods"."expected_income" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

pledge_amount.name: pledge_amount
pledge_amount.value: "goal_pledges"."amount" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000 AND ("goal_pledges"."matched_amount" IS NULL OR "goal_pledges"."matched_amount" BETWEEN 1 AND 2000000000000)

goal_amount_range.name: goal_amount_range
goal_amount_range.value: "goals"."target_amount" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "goals"."consumed_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND "goals"."target_amount" AND ("goals"."completed_amount" IS NULL OR "goals"."completed_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)

statement_file_status.name: statement_file_status
statement_file_status.value: "statement_files"."upload_status" IN ('pending','ready','failed','missing','deleting') AND ("statement_files"."upload_status"!='ready' OR "statement_files"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

rule_enabled.name: rule_enabled
rule_enabled.value: "transaction_rules"."active" IN (0,1) AND "transaction_rules"."stop_processing" IN (0,1) AND ("transaction_rules"."blocked_reason" IS NULL OR "transaction_rules"."active"=0)

transfer_detail_amounts.name: transfer_detail_amounts
transfer_detail_amounts.value: "transfer_details"."from_amount" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000 AND "transfer_details"."to_amount" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000000000 AND "transfer_details"."source_fee" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND "transfer_details"."destination_fee" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000
